stage: exact-fact semantic triage, not content admission
scope: Complete authored stems, alternatives, keys, explanations, distractor rationales and available code were compared for these three pairs. Product documentation, technical accuracy, difficulty and the final originality rubric remain the responsibility of the actual independent technical/adversarial passes.

pairs.disposition: No semantic-duplicate hold at these hashes; preserve the actual contract distinction.
pairs.reason: The conventional, non-sidecar App Service item tests the WEBSITES_PORT application setting rather than image pull or logging configuration. The AKS item separately requires retaining the client-facing Service port while correcting targetPort to a different Pod listener; its alternatives deliberately confuse those two named Kubernetes fields. The field contracts, not the changed numeric ports or product names, support retaining separate questions.
pairs.limitation: This does not certify the plausibility of the App Service distractors or the claimed difficulty. Independent quality review can still reject either item.

pairs.disposition: Related capacity concepts, with a distinct concrete boundary in the new item.
pairs.reason: The Container Apps item concerns the useful partition-reader concurrency of one fixed Event Hubs consumer group when every partition already has an assigned consumer. The DP-700 item concerns extrapolating a destination benchmark to end-to-end throughput, including a second nonpartitioned CDC source and the benchmark topology. It does not test the fixed group's reader-assignment ceiling. The generic lesson that scaling is bounded is not alone sufficient for either precise comparison.
pairs.limitation: The full technical reviewer must still establish the exact consumer-group/scaler claim and assess whether the stem supplies too much of its own answer.

pairs.disposition: Closely related compatibility rule; no automatic duplicate rejection based on product overlap.
pairs.reason: The PostgreSQL item tests the concrete cosine-distance operator <=> paired with vector_cosine_ops after the query changed to <->; its valid L2 alternative would change the required metric. The SQL item tests supplying a missing ANN index on both the required column and Euclidean metric when the current query already measures the required metric. The exact PostgreSQL operator/operator-class mapping is additional implementation knowledge, not just a renamed Azure SQL index.
pairs.limitation: This distinction depends on retaining the exact implementation task. If either is rewritten as a generic 'make index and query metrics agree' slogan, it must be compared again. Final originality scoring and source accuracy are not granted here.
